events.body:
## Context

BLT-CVE (`blt-cve/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-cve): it meets 93% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **README shows how to run it.** Add a "Run locally" (or Install / Getting started) section to the README with the exact commands in a code block, including how to run the tests.

## Notes

- The docs are linked as raw `.md` files; render them as pages.
- `public/assets/blt-cve-hero.png` is no longer used by the page and can go.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README shows how to run it
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-cve` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-cve
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-cve
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
